hero.title: Palar Agricultural College
hero.summary: Palar Agricultural College is a TNAU-affiliated college at Kothamarikuppam in Vellore district. Founded in 2017 under RS Educational and Charitable Trust, it offers a four-year agriculture degree. Its published admissions page explains TNAU ranking for both counselling and management applicants.

overview.heading: A Vellore district college focused on agriculture
paragraphs: Palar Agricultural College was established in 2017 under RS Educational and Charitable Trust. It is located at Kothamarikuppam Village, Mailpatti Post, in Vellore district and offers a four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture under TNAU affiliation.

Its academic divisions cover crop science and associated subjects, with agricultural teaching units and student-support cells listed across the campus website. The extension department describes rural learning and farmer engagement through RAWE. Applicants can ask how the teaching units and village activities fit together across the degree, while confirming admission ranking requirements and the complete cost of attendance.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: A four-year agriculture degree listed on the college site. The wider academic structure includes agronomy, crop improvement, plant protection, horticulture and soil-related divisions.
programmes.eligibility: The official college admission page requires the applicable TNAU eligibility norms. Current subject combinations, category thresholds and equivalence rules were not independently verified.
programmes.admission_route: The undated official page describes 65% through TNAU single-window counselling and 35% directly through PAC under TNAU eligibility and merit; TNAU ranking is requested for both.

fees.note: The official admission page says fees follow Government of Tamil Nadu prescriptions but provides no verified dated numeric schedule.

programmes.icar_scope_note: The audited ICAR row covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Palar Agricultural College, Vellore for 2026-03-16 to 2031-03-15. Printed intake is retained in recognition as historical scope.

admissions.heading: Planning an application to PAC
admissions.intro: PAC instructs candidates to register with TNAU and obtain ranking for counselling as well as management admission. Its fee section refers to the Government of Tamil Nadu’s prescribed structure without publishing a verified numeric schedule.

steps.title: Obtain TNAU ranking
steps.text: The official page asks applicants for both admission channels to register through the TNAU admission website.

steps.title: Confirm allocation and costs
steps.text: Ask the college for the current sanctioned seat allocation, applicable merit rules and a written fee breakdown.

campus.heading: Agricultural teaching units listed by PAC
campus.intro: PAC’s official site lists agricultural teaching units, while its extension department describes rural engagement through RAWE and village appraisal. Confirm the current cohort’s fieldwork schedule and teaching-unit access.

facilities.name: Agricultural teaching units
facilities.description: The official site lists an apiary, mushroom cultivation and vermicompost units.

facilities.name: Central library
facilities.description: A dedicated central-library section is listed on the college website.

facilities.name: Student hostels and welfare spaces
facilities.description: PAC publishes separate accommodation for male and female students. Its listed common facilities include a computer-equipped reading room, sick bay, guest room and television hall; hostel records cover entry/exit, complaints and medical matters.

practical_learning: The official site publishes activity material labelled mushroom cultivation and hand pollination in watermelon.
The extension department describes RAWE and village work, including participatory rural-appraisal exercises in Pallalakuppam.

student_services.name: Student hostels and welfare spaces
student_services.description: PAC publishes separate accommodation for male and female students. Its listed common facilities include a computer-equipped reading room, sick bay, guest room and television hall; hostel records cover entry/exit, complaints and medical matters.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: Palar has a Scholarship Cell that helps students identify schemes, understand eligibility and prepare application documentation. The page does not publish an institution-specific award amount or a current scheme decision; ask for the exact authority notice before budgeting a concession.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: The college lists a Career Guidance and Placements Cell and publishes civil-services awareness material. Individual postgraduate admission achievements and awareness activities should not be counted as a programme-wide employment rate. No dated agriculture placement statistics were verified.

recognition.heading: Recognition and programme accreditation

faqs.question: Where is PAC located?
faqs.answer: PAC lists Kothamarikuppam Village, Mailpatti Post, Vellore District, Tamil Nadu 635805.

faqs.question: Who established Palar Agricultural College?
faqs.answer: The official home page dates establishment to 2017 under RS Educational and Charitable Trust.

faqs.question: Is TNAU registration required for direct college admission?
faqs.answer: The published procedure asks candidates to obtain TNAU ranking for both counselling and management admission. Confirm the current cycle’s requirements.

faqs.question: Are numeric fees verified?
faqs.answer: No. The fee page refers to government prescriptions without a verified dated amount in the readable text.

faqs.question: When does the audited ICAR term end?
faqs.answer: The register records 16 March 2026 to 15 March 2031 for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture.

faqs.question: What entry qualification is published for PAC?
faqs.answer: The official college admission page requires the applicable TNAU eligibility norms. Current subject combinations, category thresholds and equivalence rules were not independently verified.
